title: 12 Best Food Halls in Accra
description: Discover Accra's top food halls and culinary hubs! From vibrant street food markets to modern gourmet complexes, find your next unforgettable meal in Ghana's capital.

places.name: The Food Garage
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A gourmet burger from one of the specialized stalls, paired with fresh 'sobolo' (hibiscus drink).

places.name: Kozo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore the diverse menus; the sushi at the Japanese spot is particularly renowned, or try the signature cocktails from the central bar.

places.name: The Mix Design Hub
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A fresh smoothie bowl or a gourmet sandwich from their cafe, and grab some artisan bread to go.

places.name: Accra Mall Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grab a combo meal from your favorite international chain or try a local Ghanaian dish from one of the smaller vendors.

places.name: Osu Night Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grilled tilapia with hot pepper sauce and banku, or a plate of 'red-red' (beans and plantain). Don't forget a fresh coconut!

places.name: Marina Mall Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A fresh juice from one of the beverage stalls and a Shawarma, or a pasta dish from the Italian vendor.

places.name: Palace Mall Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A Ghanaian rice dish like Jollof or Waakye from a local vendor, or explore the Indian options for something different.

places.name: The Hive
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A specialty coffee and a freshly prepared salad bowl, or a unique African fusion dish from one of the kitchens.

places.name: Makola Market Street Food Stalls
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try 'Kenkey and Fried Fish' or 'Banku and Okro Stew' from a trusted vendor. Ask for recommendations from locals if unsure.

places.name: A&C Mall Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic burger and fries, or a refreshing fruit juice from one of the stands.

places.name: Lagon Food Court (University of Ghana)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A generous plate of jollof rice with chicken, or a local stew with fufu or banku.

places.name: Icon House Food Stalls
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A freshly brewed coffee and a grab-and-go sandwich or pastry for breakfast/lunch.
